prospects.name: Email Draft (with unsubscribe + personalisation)
prospects.subject: Quick question
prospects.body:
Hi [Name or Business],
I'm James, the founder of Not Forgotten.
[PERSONALISATION — one short, truthful, verified sentence about their business.]
I noticed we sent you a few emails about our quote follow-up service and I wanted to reach out personally — not to sell you anything, but to learn.
If you have 30 seconds, I'd genuinely appreciate your take: what made our service not the right fit for you?
No wrong answers. If you don't need it, don't want it, or went another direction — that's honestly helpful to know.
And if you'd prefer I didn't email again, just say the word. To stop receiving emails from Not Forgotten, simply reply 'unsubscribe'.
Thanks for your time.
James
